input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== 5432 listening? =="; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5432 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "pid=$($_.OwningProcess) addr=$($_.LocalAddress):$($_.LocalPort)" }; echo "== our servers still alive? =="; foreach ($p in 8080,8082) { $c=New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $c.Connect('127.0.0.1',$p); "port $p => UP" } catch { "port $p => DOWN" } finally { $c.Close() } }; echo "== DB-backed endpoint =="; $sw=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/companies' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "COMPANIES => HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString('0.0'))s body=$($r.Content.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(300,$r.Content.Length)))" } catch { $resp=$_.Exception.Response; if ($resp) { $sr=New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($resp.GetResponseStream()); "COMPANIES => HTTP $([int]$resp.StatusCode) $($sr.ReadToEnd())" } else { "COMPANIES ERR => $($_.Exception.Message)" } }
